Messages.Author: Marc Erl
Messages.Body:
Okay, just another frequently asked question, and one we keep argueing
about in our play circle: I declare a bleed and my prey decides not to
block. THEN I play a Conditioning at superior Dominate, thus increasing
the bleed to a total of 4. May my prey now change her mind about
blocking???

Second question: Do I have to pay the cost in blood for a blocked action
like Kine Dominance? If not, do I have to pay the blood cost for certain
intercept cards (like Telepathic Misdirection) when the block is not
successful in the end??
Bye Marc

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Marc Erl <er...@uni-muenster.de> writes:

>Okay, just another frequently asked question, and one we keep argueing
>about in our play circle: I declare a bleed and my prey decides not to
>block. THEN I play a Conditioning at superior Dominate, thus increasing
>the bleed to a total of 4. May my prey now change her mind about
>blocking???

No. The decision not to block is final. (Tho reaction cards (like

deflection) could still be played).

>Second question: Do I have to pay the cost in blood for a blocked action

>like Kine Dominance? If not, do I have to pay the blood cost for certain
>intercept cards (like Telepathic Misdirection) when the block is not
>successful in the end??

The cost for a blocked action is *not* paid. The cost for any action
modifiers/reaction cards *is* paid for, immediately as the card
is played.

: pumps up a bleed with some modifier card (conditioning) ..that i
: could still play a wake with evening freshness.. (Reaction0 .. and
: block?? (Doesn't sound right to me)

Because it isn't right. You CAN use a wakey wakey, but you can't block.
However, (as the card states), your freshly awake vamp. can now actually
play reaction cards like deflection...

-James

No. This means that after you have decided not to block, and they play
conditioning, you can go ahead and Wake with Evening's Freshness, and
Telepathic Counter/ Deflection. The descision not to block is final, there is
currently no reaction card that allows you to get around that (though there
should be).
